subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace discovery silently omit hooks whose package.json or HOOK.md exceeds 1 MiB, or emit a recovery-oriented warning?
rationale: The fixed limit can disable a previously discoverable hook after upgrade, while current source and discussion do not establish silent omission as the intended compatibility contract.

options.title: Warn and skip
options.body: Keep the hard limit but log the affected metadata path and limit so users can recover the hook.

options.title: Accept silent omission
options.body: Approve oversized metadata as another silently invalid workspace hook and encode that contract in focused tests.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip
recommendation.body: Keep the hard limit but log the affected metadata path and limit so users can recover the hook.

likelyOwner.reason: His history most directly owns workspace hook discovery and its user-visible failure behavior.
